name: stefano-biddau-portfolio
_comment_overrides: esbuild pinned to ^0.28.0 for dedup only — GHSA-67mh is fixed upstream by all consumers now (nuxt's nitropack ^0.28.2, vite ^0.27 || ^0.28, @nuxt/fonts' unplugin and @unhead/bundler as open peers); only @nuxtjs/i18n's @intlify/bundle-utils@11.2.8 still asks ^0.25.4, and without this override npm would install two esbuild copies since ^0.25.4 doesn't overlap ^0.28.0 — drop it once bundle-utils moves to ^0.28 (see .sb-context/dependency-notes.json)

_comment_dependencies.nuxt: exact pin on purpose (no caret): every Nuxt bump is re-validated with typecheck + build + prerender + nuxt dev before it lands
_comment_dependencies.typescript: held at 6.x: TypeScript 7 ships no classic JS compiler API, which vue-tsc/@volar (nuxt typecheck) needs, and @typescript-eslint peers typescript <6.1.0 (note typescript@7.0.2)
_comment_dependencies.minimatch: transitive, build/dev only: advisory GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 stays because archiver 8.0.0 (nitropack) still pulls readdir-glob ^3 with minimatch 10.x; npm only offers a downgrade of nuxt (note minimatch@11.0.1)
_comment_dependencies.deepmerge: transitive: waiting for a release after 4.3.1 (note deepmerge@>4.3.1)
_comment_dependencies.esbuild: override kept for dedup only, see _comment_overrides (note esbuild@drop override)
_comment_dependencies.@devframes/agentic: transitive, dev tools only: devframe 1.4.0 (via @nuxt/fonts) wants optional peer 1.4.0, the lockfile keeps 1.3.2 from @eslint/config-inspector; npm ls warns, nothing breaks (note @devframes/agentic@1.4.0)
